module: "Track Layout" sub-window of the race editor (raceEditor). It sets the default lap count (defaultLaps, minimum 1), the start and end nodes (startNode, endNode), the normal, reverse, rolling and rolling reverse start positions (defaultStartPosition, reverseStartPosition, rollingStartPosition, rollingReverseStartPosition) and the "Simplify AI Path" option (simplifyAiPath). It displays the classification computed by path:classify() (Reversible, Rolling Start, Closed, Branching) and draws the "Stop Control" and "Split N" labels in the world. Changes via editor.history. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/trackLayout')(raceEditor).
notes: A start position named STOP_ZONE, SS_stop_control or TC_out is recognized as a stop zone and gets the text "Stop Control" in the world.
Nodes marked useAsSplit (except the last of the sorted list) are numbered "Split 1", "Split 2"... in the world.
An open track cannot have more than one lap; a closed track does not need an End Node (code tooltips).
C:selector indexes objects.objects[self.path[fieldName]]: the value -1 ("None") relies on the collection returning a "missing" object for that index.

C.desc: Track Layout window (windowDescription = 'Track Layout'). Instantiated with init(raceEditor).

setPath.desc: Sets the race path being edited.

selected.desc: Called when the tab becomes active; does nothing.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left; does nothing.

draw.desc: Called every frame: draws the form, the stop zone and the splits.

changeField.desc: If the new value differs from path[field], commits a history action that modifies this path field.

field.desc: Path field (defaultLaps, startNode, endNode, defaultStartPosition, simplifyAiPath...).

new.desc: New value (object ID, -1 for none, number or boolean).

drawGeneralInfo.desc: Draws the form (laps, nodes, start positions, classification, AI simplification option) then the stop zone and the splits.

displayClassification.desc: Displays a "name" line with a check or cross icon depending on classification[field].

drawStopZone.desc: Looks for a start position named STOP_ZONE, SS_stop_control or TC_out and draws the text "Stop Control" there.

drawSplits.desc: Draws "Split N" on each useAsSplit pathnode (except the last node of the sorted list).

selector.desc: Dropdown to choose a node or a position for a path field (None = -1), with a label drawn in the world and a preview of the hovered name.

fieldName.desc: Path field containing the chosen ID.

clrI.desc: Background color of the in-world text.
